verdict.rationale: Otter's own homepage claims "live transcription in multiple languages" (otter-docs-22), a documented first-party capability for this story, but it is a single thin mention with no language list. Nothing shows that summaries work in non-English languages or that mid-meeting language switching is handled. missing for 10: list of supported languages, non-English summary support, handling of language switching within a meeting, independent or hands-on corroboration of non-English accuracy.
